reviewInputEvidence.note: First live walkthrough of Neighborhood Book Club, run immediately after CJM.9-13 (+11c) fixed the sideload no-op and 5 shared-code UX findings on Garden Club. This walkthrough exists partly to test whether those shared-code fixes generalize to a second, differently-themed, differently-fielded community (Book Club uses its own field names like ownerPersonaId-equivalent 'holderPersonaId' and its own tab set Home/Calendar/Marketplace/Messages, distinct from Garden Club's Home/Exchange/Calendar/Organize).
